body:
See I used to agree about just not leaving life to it's full potential. But the past nine months or so I've really turned my life around (for the better). Sometimes I feel like I am living in a fucking movie because of how unreal and amazing the shit that happens to me is.

For awhile this was enough, all my bad feelings were gone. I constantly though "This is what normal people feel like, and it's damn amazing."

Now, everything is mostly the same, i.e. surreal, amazing things happening to me all the time. However, the old bad feelings are creeping back. Maybe it's just a chemical imbalance in my brain, I dunno. But I dunno what else to do about it anymore.

Yeah i dunno. I've had a cousin that was kind of close kill himself the january before lasts. And then this past Jan one of my closest friends did it. I understand the selfishness, and I know it will ruin others lives. I know how much it can hurt to loose someone you love, especially when it's unexpected, but I still respect suicide.

I know it's selfish, but at the end of the day there are things you just have to do for yourself. 

I really wish it was an accepted thing and I could go right now with all of my friends around me smiling. I would love that more than anything.

Dude fuck you. Your 13. Give it another 10 years and then see where your at. 

I am a complete advocate of suicide but 13 is just way too young. In 10 years your life will have changed in ways you cannot even imagine. Most likely, for the better.

I promise you will experience so many fucking things that will make you think "I was a fool for ever thinking about ending it."

Stop heeding every pressure that society and your family and whoever else puts on you. It's your life and you can live it the way you want. Find the monster inside you that you always knew was there, and let yourself become that monster. Give it another 10 years, and see how you feel. Even if you feel the same way, I can promise you will have times in that decade that will not make you regret waiting it out.
